# Crate/feature configurations that do not currently lint clean, one "<crate> <feature>" per
# line ("<none>" means --no-default-features with no extra feature).
#
# This file is DEBT, not policy. Tracked in https://github.com/zcash/librustzcash/issues/2807,
# which groups these into their ~8 root causes and suggests an order. The `clippy-feature-combos` job lints every crate against every
# one of its features; a configuration listed here is allowed to fail, anything else is not. That
# makes the job green today while still failing on any NEW breakage.
#
# The entries fall into three kinds:
#
#   1. The configuration does not compile at all, because a trait impl or a bench needs a feature
#      the configuration does not enable (zcash_client_sqlite is missing `get_locked_outputs`;
#      zcash_primitives' benches need `sapling::prover`). These are real feature-gating bugs.
#   2. Dead code: an item used only under some other feature, left ungated (most of pczt).
#   3. Ordinary clippy lints that happen to be reachable only in that configuration
#      (zcash_keys+orchard: an unneeded `return`, a loop that never loops).
#
# To burn one down: fix the configuration, delete the line. The job prints a notice when a listed
# configuration starts passing, so the list cannot rot silently.
zcash_client_sqlite <none>
zcash_client_sqlite expensive-tests
zcash_client_sqlite multicore
zcash_client_sqlite orchard
zcash_client_sqlite pczt-tests
zcash_client_sqlite serde
zcash_client_sqlite spend-index
zcash_client_sqlite transparent-inputs
zcash_client_sqlite transparent-key-import
zcash_client_sqlite unstable
zcash_client_sqlite zcashd-compat
zcash_client_sqlite zewif
zcash_client_sqlite zip-233
